officialStatusIndex.fieldMeaning: The displayed dates are approval dates in the influencing-instrument index; they are not, by themselves, Gazette publication dates or effective dates.

amendment1358.title: لایحه قانونی اصلاح ماده ۱۷ قانون صدور چک
amendment1358.textObservation: The rendered text states that the single-article measure had legal force only through the end of 1358 and applied only to cheques issued through 1358/04/31. This is recorded as a portal text observation, not an event-date legal conclusion.

amendment1397.title: قانون اصلاح قانون صدور چک
amendment1397.textObservation: The rendered official portal text describes electronic cheques, the tracking-code and seal requirements for non-payment certificates, post-notice banking restrictions, and the conditions for judicial execution under Article 23. This is a rendered text observation only, not a conclusion about the version applicable to any event date.

amendment1400.title: قانون اصلاح قانون صدور چک
amendment1400.textObservation: The rendered official portal text removes the former three-year cheque-validity language from Article 6, revises the transition rule by cheque-book delivery date around the end of Esfand 1399, and adds Article 24 on guaranteed cheques. The historical event-date interval still requires the full amendment chain and independent Gazette verification.

amendment1372.title: قانون اصلاح موادي از قانون صدور چك مصوب تيرماه 1355
amendment1372.textObservation: The official rendered text identifies the 1372/08/11 amendment and displays its eight-article enactment. This records the portal text only; it does not determine which provision applies to a particular cheque event.
amendment1372.metadataObservation: The official Qavanin attribute page displays Gazette issue 14189, publication 1372/09/01, promulgation 1372/08/25 and effective date 1372/09/17.
amendment1372.note: The page-rendered official text and metadata are research observations only. The exact response bytes, SHA-256, original Gazette issue file and independent human review bound to those bytes remain outstanding.
